lines: Still Renovating beat the living shit out of DetroitDumpsterFire, 164.5 to 76.4. That's not a matchup, that's a fucking crime scene.
Ramrod dropped 191.6 in week 8. Hottest fucking lineup in the league, and they won't shut up about it.
Rebuilding Morehouse’s put up a pathetic 64.5. A kicker and a prayer would've scored more.
A new dawn rising left 17.6 points rotting on the bench with Mike Gesicki sitting there while Cade Otton took a dump. Benching genius.
Badfish scored 141.3 and still fucking lost. The fantasy gods took a dump on that roster.
